moments.title: The Hundred Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with multiple men's and women's matches today and throughout the next week.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Catch all the fast-paced action! The Hundred is heating up, with matches taking place across the country today and all week. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: It's a big day for Welsh Fire! Both men's and women's teams are in action at Sophia Gardens today in The Hundred. Get behind our local heroes!

moments.title: Wrexham AFC Kicks Off USA Tour
moments.blurb: Wrexham AFC begins their highly anticipated US pre-season tour today, facing Leeds United in Tampa, Florida, followed by matches against Liverpool and Sunderland.

angles.name: Tour Start Today
angles.copy: Hollywood-owned Wrexham AFC are Stateside! Their US pre-season tour kicks off today against Leeds United. Can they make another splash across the pond?

angles.name: Welsh Pride
angles.copy: Our boys from Wrexham are flying the Welsh flag high in the USA! First stop, Tampa, to take on Leeds United. Good luck, lads!

moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games Underway
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games are currently ongoing, bringing together athletes from across the Commonwealth until August 2nd.

angles.name: Games in Full Swing
angles.copy: It's an action-packed week in Glasgow as the Commonwealth Games continue! Which events are you most excited to watch?

angles.name: Scottish Focus
angles.copy: Glasgow is shining on the world stage! The Commonwealth Games are bringing incredible sporting moments right to our doorstep. Go Team Scotland!

moments.title: Latitude Festival Concludes Today
moments.blurb: The Latitude Festival at Henham Park, Suffolk, wraps up today after a weekend of music, arts, and comedy.

angles.name: Festival Farewell
angles.copy: It's the final day at Latitude! If you've been there, what's been your highlight? If not, what festival are you hitting next?

angles.name: Suffolk's Big Weekend
angles.copy: Another incredible Latitude Festival weekend draws to a close in Suffolk! Hope everyone had a fantastic time. Roll on next year!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Make Chart History
moments.blurb: 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean has equalled the record for the longest-running UK number-one single of all time with 18 non-consecutive weeks, as of the chart week ending July 30, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just equalled the all-time record for UK No.1 weeks. An absolute anthem!

angles.name: Unstoppable Hit
angles.copy: Eighteen weeks at number one! Is 'Rein Me In' the greatest chart topper ever? What a run for Sam Fender and Olivia Dean!

moments.title: Summer Holidays in Full Swing
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are well underway across the UK, with families enjoying the peak of the summer break.

angles.name: Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Sun's out (hopefully!) and schools are out! Are you making the most of the summer holidays with staycations or adventures abroad?

angles.name: Local Activities
angles.copy: Devon's buzzing with families enjoying the summer holidays! What local spots are you hitting up with the kids this week?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Begins Next Week
moments.blurb: The prestigious AIG Women's Open golf championship tees off on Wednesday, July 29th, at Royal Lytham & St Annes.

angles.name: Major Golf Event
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class golf! The AIG Women's Open starts next Wednesday. Who are your picks for the title?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Kate Bush!
moments.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Kate Bush will celebrate her 68th birthday on Thursday, July 30th.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Running up that... birthday! The one and only Kate Bush turns 68 on Thursday. What's your favourite track from the legend?

angles.name: Influence & Legacy
angles.copy: Ahead of her 68th birthday, we're celebrating the unparalleled artistry of Kate Bush. Her influence is still felt everywhere!

moments.title: Oasis Knebworth 2026 Rumours Dismissed
moments.blurb: Liam Gallagher has explicitly denied rumours of Oasis playing Knebworth in 2026, stating the band has no plans for live shows next year, except for the World Cup.

angles.name: Knebworth Not Happening
angles.copy: Bad news, Oasis fans: Liam Gallagher has shut down all rumours of Knebworth 2026 gigs, confirming 'nothing going on next year except the WC'. Still, we can dream, right?

angles.name: Rumour Mill Stops
angles.copy: The Knebworth rumours have been put to bed by Liam Gallagher himself. No Oasis in 2026, but the 'WC' comment still has fans talking!

moments.title: Summer Nights at the Bandstand Returns
moments.blurb: The Summer Nights at the Bandstand concert series kicks off its eleventh year in Glasgow's Kelvingrove Park on Monday, July 27th.

angles.name: Glasgow Gigs Start
angles.copy: Get ready for some incredible live music! Summer Nights at the Bandstand begins its run in Kelvingrove Park on Monday. Who are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Y-Not Festival Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: Y-Not Festival returns to Derbyshire from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring headliners like The Libertines, Reytons, Two Door Cinema Club, and The Streets.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Y-Not Festival is just days away! Derbyshire is about to get loud with The Libertines, The Streets and more taking the stage. Who's going?

moments.title: Grace Jones at Crystal Palace Bowl
moments.blurb: The iconic Grace Jones is set to headline Palace Bowl Presents at London's Crystal Palace Bowl on Friday, July 31st, with special guests Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Grace Jones in London! The trailblazing icon plays Crystal Palace Bowl next Friday with Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul. Get ready for a show!

moments.title: Luke Combs Takes Over Wembley
moments.blurb: American country rock superstar Luke Combs brings his My Kinda Saturday Night Tour to Wembley Stadium for three nights, starting Friday, July 31st.

angles.name: Country Rock Invasion
angles.copy: Wembley is going country! Luke Combs kicks off three nights of his My Kinda Saturday Night Tour next Friday. Who's got their cowboy boots ready?
